gloss: merits and demerits; pros and cons

definitions.gloss: merits and demerits; pros and cons
definitions.explanation: The good points and bad points of something or someone. Often used when evaluating the overall impact or contribution.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{功罪|こうざい}⟦について→について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: To think about the pros and cons of the internet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{功罪|こうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}する→評価：03583_hyouka⟧。
examples.english: To evaluate the merits and demerits of his policies.

examples.japanese: {功罪|こうざい}⟦{相半|あいなか}ばする→相半ばする：noentry⟧。
examples.english: The merits and demerits are about equal.

notes:
{功罪|こうざい} combines {功|こう} (merit, achievement) and {罪|ざい} (fault, crime).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {功罪|こうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}う→問う：02299_tou⟧: to question the merits and demerits
- {功罪|こうざい}⟦{相半|あいなか}ばする→相半ばする：noentry⟧: merits and demerits are about equal
- {功罪|こうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{論|ろん}じる→論じる：02332_ronjiru⟧: to discuss the pros and cons
